title: Student Account Claim & Role Routing Emergency Fix (v0.4.39)
message: Resolved critical issue where claimed students entered Educator Dashboard. Added automatic self-healing for affected learner accounts.
changelog:
🚨 CRITICAL EMERGENCY UPDATE v0.4.39:
• Student Role Isolation: Fixed handle detection so students with @usernames are never misidentified as teachers during account claiming or passkey resets.
• Account Self-Healing: Corrupted student accounts mistakenly stamped with educator roles are now automatically detected and healed to student status upon app launch.
• Strict Target Role Routing: Guaranteed 'student' target role propagation during credential claiming and initial force password dialogs.
• Credential Vault Role Integrity: Embedded explicit role attributes in teacher reset slips and admin portal passkey generation.
